intro.label: The Journey
intro.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Ghorepani Poon Hill is a popular short trekking destination in the Annapurna region of Nepal. Known for its stunning sunrise views over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri Mountain range, Poon Hill sits at an elevation 10,532 feet.

groups.title: Poon Hill Trek
prose: This classic trekking area is good for beginners, families, and groups who are looking for immersion into big mountains without the time to spend multiple weeks getting into or around base camp regions in Nepal.
Drive to Hile and trek to Ulleri: Approximately 3 hours / Altitude: 6430 feet
Trek to Ghode Pani: Approximately 6 hours / Altitude: 9383 feet
Trek to Tada Pani: Approximately 7 hours / Altitude: 8629 feet
Trek to Ghandruk and Drive to Pokhara: Approximately 3 hours / Altitude 2690 feet

highlights.title: Acclimatization
highlights.body: Though 10,000 feet is high for most people coming from the US or Europe, it is relatively low or average for Nepal. Still, our guides are tuned in to how each of our guests are feeling and will take care to help you acclimatize in an appropriate way.

highlights.title: Mountain Flights
highlights.body: There are two short mountain flights on this itinerary. The first takes you from Kathmandu to Pokhara and the second from Pohkara to Kathmandu. These small flights are a quintessential element to travel within Nepal.

cards.title: What to expect in Kathmandu
cards.body: You may have started this journey with an interest in the mountains of Nepal but no trip is complete without a good experience in Kathmandu. From the moment you meet your guide at the airport in Kathmandu, you are in good hands. There is no need to navigate the airport scene or figure out how to find your hotel in the back alleys of Boudha or Thamel. Don't worry, there is ample opportunity to get out and explore. You will be able to immerse yourself in the bustling network of alleys, streets, and buildings as you take in the city. Our guides, however, take care of the details so you can take in the surroundings. Your time in Kathmandu will also include good food, getting to know your guide, and an orientation for the trek. By the time we depart the city, everyone will be prepared for the mountains and your cultural curiosity will have been stoked.

cards.title: Trekking in the Annapurna Region
cards.body: The average day's trek for this journey is 3-6 hours, allowing ample time to get from point to point each day. Evenings are spent in local village guest houses and guides will help with each detail of the day allowing you to focus on the trail.

cards.title: Pokhara
cards.body: Pokhara is the second most populous city in Nepal but it is very different when compared to Kathmandu. It is located on the shore of Phewa Lake. Three of the world's ten highest mountains (Dhaulagiri, Annapurna I and Manaslu) are within 35 miles of the valley, though Pokhara is only 822m or 2696 ft above sea level.
